privacy.introPart2: (CR: 7053753773) protecting your privacy and safeguarding your personal data. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our website or services.

sections.title: 1. Information We Collect
sections.body:
We collect information you voluntarily provide when filling out booking forms or contacting us, including:
• Full name and phone number
• Email address
• Trip details (destination, travel date, number of travelers)
• Departure city and trip duration
• Any notes or special requests you mention

We also automatically collect some technical data such as IP address and browser type for security and performance improvement purposes.

sections.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.body:
We use the collected information for the following purposes:
• Processing and responding to booking requests
• Communicating with you about your trip or our offers
• Improving our services and user experience on our site
• Complying with legal and regulatory requirements in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia

We will not use your data for any marketing purpose without obtaining your prior consent.

sections.title: 3. Sharing Information with Third Parties
sections.body:
We do not sell or rent your personal data to any third party. We may only share your information in the following cases:
• With travel partners (hotels, airlines) necessary to complete your booking
• When legally required or under a court order
• With trusted technical service providers acting on our behalf under confidentiality agreements

sections.title: 4. Data Retention and Protection
sections.body:
We retain your data for as long as necessary to provide the service or as required by law.
We take appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, loss, or misuse, including encryption of communications.

sections.title: 5. Your Rights
sections.body:
You have the right at any time to:
• Access the data we hold about you
• Request correction of any inaccurate information
• Request deletion of your data (within legal limits)
• Withdraw your consent to any optional processing

To contact us regarding your rights: almajara.alkawnia.travel@gmail.com

sections.title: 6. Cookies
sections.body: Our website uses essential cookies to ensure the site functions correctly, and may use analytical cookies to understand how visitors use the site. You can adjust your browser settings to refuse these cookies, though this may affect some site functionality.

sections.title: 7. Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We reserve the right to update this privacy policy at any time. The updated version will be posted on this page with the last modification date. We encourage you to review the policy periodically.

sections.title: 8. Contact Us
sections.body:
If you have any questions about this policy, you can contact us via:

📧 Email: almajara.alkawnia.travel@gmail.com
📞 Phone: +966 54 481 7995
📍 Address: Makkah Al-Mukarramah, Al Tanguim District, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
🏢 Commercial Registration: 7053753773

items: Flight tickets and hotel reservations are sent 48 hours before departure, and may be sent earlier depending on readiness.

Flight tickets are subject to the terms and conditions of the carrying airline; some tickets may be non-refundable or non-cancellable, and the company is not responsible for any changes or cancellations issued by airlines. If a client wishes to modify a booking or add extra baggage, this is done according to the airline's policy and at an additional cost borne by the client.

Hotel bookings are subject to each hotel's cancellation and modification policies; some allow free cancellation within a specific period, while others may charge fees up to the full booking value. If the client requests cancellation or modification, this is done according to the hotel's policy after review, with the client bearing any resulting additional costs. Bookings for cabins, apartments, and resorts are non-refundable.

The client has the right to modify booked hotels, provided the client bears all applicable penalties according to the type of service to be modified; the outcome of the modification depends on availability during that period.

In case of a refund, it will be processed within 10 to 21 business days at least from the date of the cancellation request. If payment was made via electronic cards (Visa/Mastercard), amounts will be refunded to the card according to the timeframe determined by the bank.

The duration of the tour is 8 to 10 hours, starting at 10:00 AM and ending at a pre-agreed time. If the client requests an extension or additional time, this is subject to availability and an additional cost determined by the office. The client may also request to change the tour start time, provided the request is submitted at least one day before the tour and coordinated with the office.

In case the traveler is returned or prevented from traveling for any reason, the office is not responsible for refunding the trip amount or any other related costs, though it may help the client book an alternative trip or reduce penalties where possible.
In case of any damage inside the room or use of any paid services such as laundry or ironing, the cost is borne by the traveler.
Triple room: the third bed is an additional foldable bed or sofa bed, not the same size or standard as the main beds.
Tour programs are subject to change in terms of the order of tours due to weather conditions or other operational circumstances.
The type of vehicle used in tour programs is determined by the company based on comfort and availability.
In case of cancellation during the trip, the full amount is deducted and the client is not entitled to any refund.
Hotel rooms are provided based on hotel availability and according to priority and capacity.
Hotel check-in begins after 2:00 PM.
Rooms must be vacated on the last day before 12:00 PM.
